note: Downloads-folder reel - posts ~09:58 BST (hourly cron at :58)
caption:
I let Claude into my Downloads folder. It found 41 files called "final".

Nine of those were called "final_FINAL". One was "final_real". I have no defence.

Nine seconds later it was sorted into twelve folders with 1.4 GB of duplicates pulled out. No code involved — this is just Claude Code pointed at a normal folder, which is the part nobody tells you it can do.

Six things to point it at that have nothing to do with programming, at the end. The other 44 are free — link in bio.

note: UGC 'three prompts' solo distribution test - posts ~09:58 BST
caption:
Three prompts I use on basically everything.

"What's the dumbest thing here?" — it will tell you, and it's usually right.
"What did you miss?" — catches the thing it quietly skipped.
"Explain it like I'm new" — turns a wall of jargon into something you can actually act on.

None of these are clever. That's the point. The other 47 are in the free pack — link in bio.
